scope: Verify the FreeCAD-compatible -o route chooses its documented default DXF target from imported DXF source revisions and from locally authored DWG source profiles, and honors ASCII/Binary output selection.

control.runtimeAuthoredInput: The minimal SOURCE DXF is written in a temporary directory with only $ACADVER varied. AC1021 and AC1027 DWGs are written by the local test writer at runtime; no binary fixture is committed.
assertions: All nine source revision headers select the expected default target, including the AC1012 compatibility mapping to AC1014.
Each target is emitted as ASCII and Binary DXF with the exact $ACADVER value.
Binary DXF is checked with the R12 one-byte group-code framing for AC1009 and two-byte framing for later revisions.
All inputs remain byte-identical and each invocation exits successfully.
Locally authored AC1021 and AC1027 DWG sources select the same default DXF target through FreeCAD -o in ASCII and Binary.
Binary outputs from both DWG profiles are reopened through FreeCAD -o and read back as ASCII at the same target revision.

validation.test: PASS: dwg2dxf_cli_contract CTest 1/1 (8.96s) after rebuilding both current executables; options-only 96 controls; batch-only 33 bounded controls including four default DWG outputs and two binary readbacks.

limits: This receipt covers source-DXF defaults for all supported revision headers and generated AC1021/AC1027 DWG defaults through FreeCAD -o; other DWG-derived versions, explicit-version semantics outside existing controls, and native CAD acceptance remain separately scoped.
This is CLI contract evidence, not a DWG/DXF semantic support claim.
